I added a 0.25s sleep after each call in `tests/test_payments.py`. At 5 requests per second the minimum spacing is 0.2s, so 0.25s leaves a small margin. The interval is a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant at the top of the file. I haven't run the test, since it hits the live sandbox.

The sleep only spaces calls within this test. If CI runs other tests against the sandbox at the same time, or runs several jobs in parallel, they share the same limit and could still trip it.
